title: Mirrodin Besieged/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Scars of Mirrodin block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: Mirrodin Besieged features four bicolored intro packs , each designed around distinct mechanics and aligned with either the Mirran or Phyrexian factions. The packs— Battle Cries (red/white, featuring battle cry and metalcraft ), Doom Inevitable (blue/black, featuring proliferate and living weapon ), Mirromancy (blue/red, focused on burn ), and Path of Blight (green/white, centered on infect ) — offer ready-to-play decks highlighting key strategies and synergies from the set.
Battle Cries is a red / white intro pack featuring battle cry and metalcraft . The deck is Mirran-aligned.
The rares in this deck are Victory's Herald (holographic foil) and White Sun's Zenith .
Doom Inevitable is a blue / black intro pack featuring proliferate and living weapon . The deck is Phyrexian-aligned.
The rares in this deck are Psychosis Crawler (holographic foil) and Bonehoard .
Mirromancy is a blue / red intro pack focused on direct-damage " burn ". The deck is Mirran-aligned.
The rares in this deck are Galvanoth (holographic foil) and Red Sun's Zenith .
Path of Blight is a green / white intro pack centered around infect . The deck is Phyrexian-aligned.
The rares in this deck are Phyrexian Hydra (holographic foil) and Decimator Web .
